Seven orchestra tracks play in this hitech drop. Every single one sits on a steep high-pass.

EQ Eight, 48 dB per octave: organ and brass at 200 Hz, choir and trumpet at 220, pizzicato at 250, glockenspiel at 400, marimba at 150. For a test I switched all seven off: below 150 Hz the orchestra got 22 dB louder, while 150 Hz to 6 kHz changed by 0.1 dB. So the orchestra keeps its sound and the low end stays free for kick and bass.

The parts also split by length: organ and choir hold each chord for two bars, pizzicato and marimba play notes under half a beat.

From Uhrwerk aus Blut, out now. Part 9 next: the EQ on my master.
